title: 歌剧俏佳人
subtitle: 热域 · 私人学习译稿

source.text: In his notes, Toby said ~ "this whole sequence is a reference to the opera in FF6 but it's just a parody so I don't care about having the tone being identical or being overly referential"
source.raw:

in FF6 but it's just a

translation.text: Toby 在说明里说：“这一整段是在模仿《FF6》的歌剧，但只是恶搞，所以我不在乎语气是否一模一样，也不必太执着于对应原作。”

source.text: Mettaton forces the main character to participate in an opera scene that includes a song with lyrics. But as we've already seen, songs don't work well when translated literally. For this reason, the translator revised the lyrics to be singable in Japanese while remaining as faithful to the original lyrics as possible:
source.raw:
Mettaton forces the main character to participate in an opera scene that includes
a song with lyrics. But as we've already seen, songs don't work well when
translated literally. For this reason, the translator revised the lyrics to be singable
in Japanese while remaining as faithful to the original lyrics as possible:

translation.text: Mettaton 强迫主角参与一场带有歌词的歌剧。前面已经看到，歌曲直接翻译往往不好唱。因此，译者在尽量忠实原词的同时，调整了歌词，使其能用日语唱出来：

source.text: And then you'll die a lot
source.raw: And then you'll die a lot

source.text: After Underta/e's Japanese release, players praised these new lyrics for "feeling like they were written in Japanese to begin with" and for "sounding even better" than the original English lyrics. From such reactions, it's clear that the translator managed to mimic the "feel" of Toby's original writing, resulting in a seamless localization.
source.raw:
After Underta/e's Japanese release, players praised these new lyrics for "feeling
like they were written in Japanese to begin with" and for "sounding even
better" than the original English lyrics. From such reactions, it's clear that the
translator managed to mimic the "feel" of Toby's original writing, resulting in a
seamless localization.

translation.text: 《Undertale》日文版发行后，玩家称赞新歌词“像是一开始就用日语写的”，甚至“比原英文还好听”。这些反应说明，译者成功重现了 Toby 原作的“感觉”，让本地化自然流畅。
